from fastapi import FastAPI
from fastapi.routing import APIRoute
from typing import Callable

app = FastAPI()

class TimingRoute(APIRoute):
    def get_route_handler(self) -> Callable:
        import time
        original = super().get_route_handler()
        async def handler(request):
            start = time.perf_counter()
            response = await original(request)
            duration = time.perf_counter() - start
            response.headers["X-Response-Time"] = str(duration)
            return response
        return handler

app.router.route_class = TimingRoute

@app.get("/timed")
def timed():
    return {"ok": True}
# What does X-Response-Time header contain?
o: The time in seconds (float) taken to handle the request
The timestamp when the response was sent
The total uptime of the server
The number of seconds remaining before a timeout
